messages: I wonder how #p407#'s doing with the hang glider... Maybe I should go check up on him in #m10003000#.

#p407# failed to build a working hang glider, and, persistent in his never-ending quest for flight, is now attempting to create a flying balloon. This seems just as preposterous as his last idea, but I don't think I can stop him, so I might as well help him. To make the flying balloon, he needs #b50 #t4000028#s#k and #b10 #t4031078#es#k. For his sake, I really hope this works...

I got the materials needed for #p407# to make a flying balloon and realize his dream of flying. I don't know if his 'flying balloon' will actually fly, but there's a chance that it might work. I'll check up on him around when the flying balloon should be ready to take flight and see if he's for real this time.
name: Icarus and the Balloon
